title: Deskfold: Adaptive task rail with temporal workspace breadcrumbs
creator: Maya Ortega
description: Problem: The current Redwood Console sidebar and workspace switcher are dense and surface too many static entries for power users while hiding recent temporal context for fast task resumption. Goal: Design an adaptive left rail ("Deskfold") that collapses non-critical items, surfaces 'temporal breadcrumbs' (recent work snapshots and routes), and exposes a compact, keyboard-first workspace lens for multi-tenant switching. Scope: IA changes to sidebar, workspace switcher microcopy, keyboard nav, mobile responsive collapse behavior, and rollout UI flags. Out of scope for this ticket: backend permission model changes and new RBAC APIs (will be handled in separate ENG tasks).
acceptance_criteria: Interactive Figma prototype that shows collapsed/expanded Deskfold with 3 user states (new, returning, power)
Prototype demonstrates keyboard shortcuts: Cmd+K to open quick-lens, Shift+" to toggle Deskfold, and arrow navigation within temporal breadcrumbs
Design token spec and responsive rules for widths, spacing, and collapse thresholds delivered to frontend
Usability test with 6 participants showing >30% decrease in mean time-to-switch compared to baseline
Accessibility audit notes (contrast, focus order, ARIA) documented and issues tracked
comments: 2025-02-09 Maya Ortega: Kickoff completed with PM and Eng. Decided to prioritize temporal breadcrumbs (recent routes + last-query snapshot) over exposing full project tree in collapsed state to keep cognitive load low.
2025-02-10 Product review (Arjun Patel): Agrees with focusing on return-to-task flows. Request: make workspace switcher show role-aware actions (View Billing if owner). Added label 'rollouts'.

2025-02-11 Engineering sync (Priya Rao): Key constraint: server must expose recent route metadata (path, lastUsedAt, pinned). If not available by GA, fall back to client-side local cache and telemetry-backed heuristics.
2025-02-12 Design iteration: Added keyboard-first micro-lens triggered by Cmd+K with fuzzy search and temporal groupings (Today | Last 7 days | Starred). Prototype updated in Figma.
2025-02-13 Accessibility review (E2): Color contrast for collapsed icons fails AA for one tertiary state. Action: adjust palette and document WCAG reasons. Filed ENG-71024 for token update.

2025-02-14 Usability lab scheduling: Booked 6 sessions with mix of power users and new signups. Test script focuses on time-to-switch, perceived clarity, and error cases when multiple tenants have similar names.

2025-02-16 Design critique (team): Two variants were considered — 'layered rail' (animated pane reveal) and 'snapper rail' (instant collapse). Decision: default to snapper for stability; layered retained as optional in animate-enabled builds.
2025-02-17 PM request (Arjun): Add telemetry events for deskfold_open, deskfold_switch, deskfold_collapse, workspace_lens_search with schema examples. Added to attachments.

2025-02-18 Engineering feedback (Liam Chen): Need explicit fallbacks for low-width screens (<960px). Proposed auto-overlay workspace-lens on mobile instead of persistent rail. Updated prototype to show overlay.
2025-02-19 Pre-review: Merged design tokens doc and proposed rollout flags (feature_flag:deskfold_alpha). Preparing design handoff package and acceptance criteria for DEV QA.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (alpha): internal-only behind feature_flag:deskfold_alpha; collect usage and keyboard metrics for 2 weeks
Phase 1 (canary): 5% of orgs with high activity; compare time-to-switch and error rates against control cohort; monitor console errors and accessibility regressions
Phase 2 (gradual): enable for 25% then 100% with opt-out in user settings and telemetry gating
Rollback: feature_flag kill switch and instant fallback to legacy sidebar; alert runbook prepared
metrics_success: Deskfold engagement (opens per active user per week) > 0.6
No increase in reported navigation-related support tickets beyond baseline
Accessibility issues severity <= 1 for release (no critical failures)
mock_user_flows: New user: first sign-in shows compact Deskfold with curated onboarding highlight for workspace quick-lens
Returning user: Deskfold shows temporal breadcrumbs: last active workspace -> last active route within that workspace -> pinned dashboards
Power user: Uses Cmd+K to jump to 'dataset-embed' workspace in under 2 seconds, demo of fuzzy match + recent query scope
Multi-tenant admin: Opens workspace switcher, sees tenant-specific billing link and can pin a workspace to keep it at top of rail
